question: Which of the following keyboard shortcuts is used to perform UNDO operation in MS-Word?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl+Z**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **UNDO operation**

 
 
• UNDO is the operation** used to reverse the effects of previous action.**
 
• UNDO is **mainly used to undone the actions.**
